```{python}
# =======
# Imports
# =======

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from scipy.stats import gmean
from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist, squareform

from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

from skbio.stats.distance import DistanceMatrix, permanova, permdisp
```

```{python}
# ==============
# Load and Merge
# ==============

samples = pd.read_parquet("hugerth_sample_profiles.parquet")

meta = pd.read_csv("meta_data.csv", encoding="utf-8-sig")
meta_sub = meta[["Run", "Subject", "Visit_No."]].rename(columns={"Run": "sample_id"})
samples = samples.merge(meta_sub, on="sample_id", how="left")

cst = pd.read_pickle("ravel_csts.df").reset_index().rename(columns={"Sample": "sample_id"})
samples = samples.merge(cst[["sample_id", "CST"]], on="sample_id", how="left")

samples = samples.dropna(subset=["CST"]).copy()
samples["CST"] = samples["CST"].astype(int)

aa_columns = ["Ala","Arg","Asn","Asp","Cys","Gln","Glu","Gly","His","Ile",
    "Leu","Lys","Met","Phe","Pro","Ser","Thr","Trp","Tyr","Val"]
pct_columns = [aa + "_pct" for aa in aa_columns]
```

```{python}
# =================
# Selecting Top Day
# =================

day_counts = samples["Visit_No."].value_counts()
print(day_counts.head())

top_day = day_counts.index[0]
day = samples[samples["Visit_No."] == top_day].copy()
print(f"selected {top_day}: {len(day)} samples")
print(day["CST"].value_counts().sort_index())
```

```{python}
X_day = day[pct_columns].values
P_day = np.where(X_day == 0, X_day[X_day > 0].min()/2, X_day)
X_clr_day = np.log(P_day/gmean(P_day, axis=1, keepdims=True))

cst_levels = sorted(day["CST"].unique())
cmap_cst = plt.get_cmap("tab10")
cst_colors = {c: cmap_cst(i) for i, c in enumerate(cst_levels)}
```

```{python}
# ===================
# CDS Count Histogram
# ===================

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.hist(day["n_cds"], bins=10, edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.5)
ax.set_title("Distribution of CDS Count per Sample (day 13)")
ax.set_xlabel("CDS count")
ax.set_ylabel("Number of samples")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# =====================
# GC vs. AA composition
# =====================

fig, axes = plt.subplots(10, 2, figsize=(12, 24))
axes = axes.flatten()
for ax, aa, pct_col in zip(axes, aa_columns, pct_columns):
    for c in cst_levels:
        m = day["CST"] == c
        ax.scatter(day.loc[m, "GC_content"], day.loc[m, pct_col],
                   color=cst_colors[c], alpha=0.6, s=20, linewidths=0)
    ax.set_title(aa)
    ax.set_xlabel("GC content (%)")
    ax.set_ylabel("AA composition (%)")

handles = [plt.Line2D([0],[0], marker="o", color="w",
           markerfacecolor=cst_colors[c], markersize=6, label=f"CST {c}")
           for c in cst_levels]
fig.legend(handles=handles, loc="lower center", ncol=len(cst_levels), fontsize=9,
           bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.01))
fig.suptitle("GC Content vs Amino Acid Composition by CST (day 13)", fontsize=16, y=1.0)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.98])
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# ======================
# PCA color coded by CST
# ======================

pca_day = PCA()
X_pca_day = pca_day.fit_transform(X_clr_day)

evr_day = pca_day.explained_variance_ratio_

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for c in cst_levels:
    m = (day["CST"] == c).values
    ax.scatter(X_pca_day[m, 0], X_pca_day[m, 1], color=cst_colors[c],
               alpha=0.7, s=30, linewidths=0, label=f"CST {c}")
ax.set_title("PCA of Sample AA Profiles by CST (day 13)")
ax.set_xlabel(f"PC1 ({evr_day[0]:.1%})")
ax.set_ylabel(f"PC2 ({evr_day[1]:.1%})")
ax.legend(title="CST")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# ==============
# PCA Scree Plot
# ==============

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))

axes[0].bar(range(1, len(evr_day)+1), 100*evr_day)
axes[0].set_title("Variance Explained per Component (day 13)")
axes[0].set_xlabel("Principal component")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Variance explained (%)")

axes[1].plot(range(1, len(evr_day)+1), 100*evr_day.cumsum(), marker="o")
axes[1].axhline(90, linestyle="--", linewidth=0.8, color="gray")
axes[1].set_title("Cumulative Variance Explained (day 13)")
axes[1].set_xlabel("Number of components")
axes[1].set_ylabel("Cumulative variance (%)")
axes[1].set_ylim(0, 105)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# ==========
# PCA Biplot
# ==========

load_day = pca_day.components_[:2].T

span = max(abs(X_pca_day[:,0]).max(), abs(X_pca_day[:,1]).max())
scale = 0.7*span/abs(load_day).max()
hw = 0.02*span

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 7))
for c in cst_levels:
    m = (day["CST"] == c).values
    ax.scatter(X_pca_day[m,0], X_pca_day[m,1], color=cst_colors[c],
               alpha=0.7, s=30, linewidths=0, label=f"CST {c}")
for i, aa in enumerate(aa_columns):
    ax.arrow(0, 0, load_day[i,0]*scale, load_day[i,1]*scale,
             linewidth=0.7, color="black", head_width=hw)
    ax.annotate(aa, (load_day[i,0]*scale, load_day[i,1]*scale), fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("PCA Biplot by CST (day 13)")
ax.set_xlabel(f"PC1 ({evr_day[0]:.1%})")
ax.set_ylabel(f"PC2 ({evr_day[1]:.1%})")
ax.legend(title="CST")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# =========
# PERMANOVA
# =========

D_day = squareform(pdist(X_clr_day, metric="euclidean"))
dm_day = DistanceMatrix(D_day, ids=day["sample_id"].astype(str).values)

res = permanova(dm_day, day["CST"].astype(str).values, permutations=9999)
print(res)
print()
res_disp = permdisp(dm_day, day["CST"].astype(str).values, permutations=9999)
print(res_disp)
```
